$comment: The source of sf-chart-sparkline (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.14 in the 1.4 form, vocabulary 1.1.5). A word-sized chart without axes for a table cell, a line of text or the chart slot of sf-chart-metric (docs/DECISIONS.md D1, D2 of ui-chart).

label.summary: What the sparkline shows, in a few words: the start of its accessible name, before the sentence of what the data does. Without it the sparkline is named «Мини-график».

items.summary: The data: a list of numbers ([3, 5, 4]), a list of records ([{day, visits}, …]) or an object of columns. A missing value (null, '', a word) is a gap, never a zero.

x.summary: For records: the field of the order (time, a number or categories); the first field when unset. A list of numbers is in its own order.

y.summary: For records: the field of the values; the first numeric field but x when unset.

shape.summary: line: one line; area: the line with the ground under it filled lightly; bar: one thin bar per value, from zero.

curve.summary: linear joins the points straight; step holds a value until the next; smooth is a curve that never goes past its points.

mark.summary: A dot on the last value (last), on the highest and the lowest (extremes), or none. For bar the marked bars are drawn in full tone.

y-zero.summary: The value axis takes zero in. bar always does.

y-format.summary: How the values are said in the accessible sentence: number, integer, decimal-<n>, percent (a share 0..1), compact or currency-<CODE>, in the page's language.

size.summary: The rung of the size ladder: the height. 1/2 sits in a line of small text or a dense table, 1 in a table row, 2 in a metric tile.

summary.summary: auto: the accessible name says what the data does after the label (the first and the last value, the highest and the lowest); none: the label alone, when the text around already says it.

data-state.summary: auto: ready with data, empty without. loading holds the box with a quiet skeleton; empty draws a dotted baseline and says «нет данных».

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16); the SVG's inside is markup set as a property.

skeleton.$comment: The items arrive after the first paint when the host loads them: the box holds its size rung's height until they do (standard 1.3.8 §5.4).

accessibility.x-keys: Not interactive and no Tab stop: an image whose name is the label and a sentence of what the data does. A host that needs the values reachable puts them in text or uses sf-chart-line.

x-summary: A sparkline: one series as a word-sized line, area or bars without axes, for a table cell, a line of text or a metric tile, named by its label and a sentence of what the data does.
x-decisions: name: sf-chart-sparkline, the Framework's naming rule sf-[set]-<block>[-<variant>], block chart (the owner's decision of 2026-11-02, ui-control control/decisions/2026-11-02-smart-component-naming.md; docs/DECISIONS.md D2), family chart.
data: items as numbers, records or columns with x and y (D3); one series, a missing value is a gap.

not interactive: no tooltip, cursor or events; a sparkline lives inside rows and tiles that are targets themselves, and a second Tab stop per row would make a table slow to walk. Its text is its accessible name.
no table and no error state: the host around it (a table, sf-chart-metric) holds the numbers and the failure; data-state stops at empty, so the public-api-axes gate has nothing to exempt.
colour: one series on the primary graphic tone until the Framework's categorical roles arrive (D4); marks on the on-surface tone, so a mark differs by tone and shape, not by colour alone.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-chart-sparkline for the shape of one series beside a number: in a table row, a sentence or the chart slot of sf-chart-metric.
do_not: Do not use it where a person must read the values; that is sf-chart-line with its axes and table
Do not replace missing values with zero
Do not draw it without a label

accessibility.focus: None: not a Tab stop. The accessible name is the label and the sentence of what the data does.

$comment: The sparkline renders no other tag, so its rule fetches nothing else.
